label: Fires at GO after an unrewarded a2-to-S2 trial, stronger early and when S1 seems good.
short_terms: (phase == GO) * last_is("a2 S2 u") ;; (phase == GO) * last_is("a2 S2 u") * ep_dec ;; (phase == GO) * last_is("a2 S2 u") * belief
terms: (phase == GO) * last_is("a2 S2 u") ;; (phase == GO) * last_is("a2 S2 u") * belief_lo ;; (phase == GO) * last_is("a2 S2 u") * (tv("reward", -2) == 0) ;; (phase == GO) * last_is("a2 S2 u") * ep_dec ;; (phase == GO) * last_is("a2 S2 u") * belief_cover ;; (phase == GO) * last_is("a2 S2 u") * belief_lo**2 ;; (phase == GO) * last_is("a1 S2 u") * belief_lo ;; (phase == GO) * last_is("a2 S2 u") * (tv("state", -2) == 2)
explanation: The feature is silent at D1 and D2. At GO it fires almost only when the previous trial was a2 -> S2 (common) and unrewarded, which is the model-based switch-to-a1 case. Within those trials it is larger early in the episode (fades with episode decile, beyond the timing baseline) and larger the more the ideal observer believes S1 is good, i.e. when the S2 failure fits the evidence. The free fit adds: the trial before also being unrewarded or also reaching S2 makes it stronger, plus small belief_cover and nonlinear belief effects. a1 S2 u gives only a weak lift. Choice/state of the current trial and the hidden good state add almost nothing. Most remaining misses are GO steps on the first trial of a window, where the previous trial is unknown, so last_is cannot see the history behind the large activations there.
